steps.what: Configure and define parameters for installation of hubs
Define testing parameters for local network routers
Define parameters for wide network switches and controllers
Define parameters for multiplexers or related networking equipment

tasks.design: The specialist configures and defines parameters for installation or testing of local area network, wide area network, hubs, routers, switches, controllers, multiplexers, or related networking equipment. The parameters stay at full effort. {OPS_SYSTEM} does not choose them.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist defines each parameter on the equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Defining installation and testing parameters stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a parameter the equipment does not support.
tasks.altitude: Defining the parameters stays at full effort. Nothing in them is shortened.

reach.task: Set the installation the parameters must serve

evidence.claim: Defining installation and testing parameters for this networking equipment stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with equipment to install or test and ends when the specialist has defined the parameters, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Applying a parameter after it is defined is a different task.
unknowns: Which parameters each kind of equipment must have before installation.
research_questions: Which parameters did the specialist refuse because the equipment did not support them?

already_counted.description: Defining parameters for installation of hubs is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: defining parameters adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every parameter is still defined by the specialist. High: the same parameter work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Install hardware or software and check integration

steps.what: Install new hardware or software systems or components
Work ensuring integration with existing network systems
Review the install note before it is filed
File the accepted network install note

tasks.design: The specialist installs new hardware or software systems or components, ensuring integration with existing network systems. The install stays at full effort. {DOCS} files only the note the specialist has accepted. A blank integration result stays blank. Filing the note does not do the install.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist installed the component and wrote the note by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted note can be filed. The install and the integration check stay manual.
tasks.still_hard: Doing the install and judging integration stay with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist refuses a note that claims integration the check did not show.
tasks.altitude: The install stays at full effort. The note is filed only after the specialist accepts that version.

reach.learn: Which notes had a blank result.

evidence.claim: Filing an accepted install note can be a later step. The install and the integration check stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a component and ends when the accepted note is filed, or the specialist stops.
An integration note has component identifier, network name, and result, entered by the specialist after the install. A blank result is left blank and is not invented.
Filing uses the note accepted in the review. It does not perform the install.
unknowns: Which existing systems a new component must work with.
research_questions: How often did a blank result stop the note?

already_counted.description: Installing the hardware or software is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a component identifier before the note is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: results are often blank, so the specialist still writes the note after the install. High: the install is done, the specialist reviews the note, and only the accepted note is filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test software or hardware with diagnostic equipment

steps.what: Test computer software using standard diagnostic testing equipment
Test computer hardware using standard diagnostic procedures

tasks.design: The specialist tests computer software or hardware, using standard diagnostic testing equipment and procedures. The test stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} runs the test or names the result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist tests the item with the equipment and the procedure.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored script replaces the test.
tasks.still_hard: Running the test and reading the result stay with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not pass an item the procedure did not cover.
tasks.altitude: The test stays at full effort. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Say which item must be tested
reach.learn: Which procedures did not cover the item.

evidence.claim: Testing computer software or hardware with diagnostic equipment stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with an item to test and ends when the specialist has tested it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A later note of the test, if one is kept, is a different task.
unknowns: Which procedures apply to software, and which apply to hardware.
research_questions: How often did the specialist refuse a pass because the procedure did not cover the item?

already_counted.description: Testing computer software is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the test adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every test is still done by the specialist. High: the same testing remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Install or repair fiber optic cables

steps.what: Install network cables, including fiber optic cables
Repair network cables, including fiber optic cables

tasks.design: The specialist installs or repairs network cables, including fiber optic cables. The work is on site and stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} pulls or repairs a cable.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist installs or repairs the cable on site.
tasks.enabler_now: No remote step replaces the cable work.
tasks.still_hard: Installing or repairing the cable stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist stops when the run is not the one on the order.
tasks.altitude: The cable work stays at full effort.

reach.learn: Which runs were the wrong path.

evidence.claim: Installing or repairing network cables, including fiber optic cables, stays on site.

assumptions: The work starts with a cable run and ends when the specialist has installed or repaired it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A later test of the cable is a different task.
unknowns: Which cable runs the specialist does, and which go to a vendor.
research_questions: How often did the specialist stop because the run was the wrong path?

already_counted.description: Installing network cables is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the cable work adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every cable is still installed or repaired by the specialist. High: the same cable work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
